assumptions: What repricing may change, and when: only at a change of cover back in time (a withdrawal by the fifteenth day of classes, Affiliate cover bought on a leave, a leave's cover canceled back). It never changes a paid bill or one in debt, and never an issued bill's plan part; it may lower an open bill's balance by a credit, recorded on it as credited. A claim standing denied isn't repriced (only Yale Health's cover moves back, and its claims aren't denied).
The plan's change on a line is a delta (negative where the plan takes its part back); a $0 visit had no bill, so its plan part is on the care log, not on a line.
Older saves' care logs have no plan part: it's read from the bill, or as none.
